title: Sino-Aerogel (Zhongke Huaan) | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Sino-Aerogel is a China-based aerogel supplier serving industrial and energy-market customers through an export-oriented product platform. The company promotes aerogel solutions for EV batteries, buildings, pipeline insulation, and other thermal-management applications, and states that its first aerogel composite material was launched about 14 years ago.

Company Overview

The company’s public site highlights building insulation, energy infrastructure efficiency, EV battery thermal protection, and pipeline applications. It presents a global-facing aerogel product catalog that includes powders, insulation pads, coatings, panels, and cryogenic materials.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Global online and export-oriented supply.
  • Focus Areas: EV battery thermal protection, building insulation, pipeline insulation, and aerogel-based thermal-management materials.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel thermal insulation ceramic coatings
  • EV battery insulation pads
  • SiO2 aerogel nano powder and aerogel particles
  • Insulation panels, pipeline insulation parts, and insulated boxes
  • Cryogenic insulation materials
  • Public Capacity: Not clearly disclosed on the reviewed pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Public Address: No. 44 Hongguang Road, Fengdong Xincheng area, Shaanxi, China.
  • International Certifications: CE / RoHS compliant according to the public website.
  • Official Website: https://sino-aerogel.com
